subject: mathematics
question_text: Let x be the arithmetic mean and let y, z be the two geometric means between any two positive numbers. Show that y³ + z³ = 2xyz.

recall_prompt: Say how you would do this one — say which progression a, y, z, b are in, and what each of y² and z² equals.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Write what the means say
steps.margin_note: First mark. a + b = 2x, and the two neighbour relations y² = az and z² = yb. Naming a, y, z, b as a G.P. is the key line.
steps.memory_tip: In a G.P. every term squared equals the product of the two terms beside it.
lines: Let the two positive numbers be a and b
x is the arithmetic mean, so x = (a + b)/2, that is  a + b = 2x
y and z are two geometric means, so a, y, z, b are in G.P.
In a G.P. each term squared is the product of its neighbours:  y² = az  and  z² = yb

recall.must_convey: That a + b = 2x, that a, y, z, b are in G.P., and that y² = az and z² = yb.
accept: a plus b equals two x from the arithmetic mean
a y z b are in geometric progression
y squared is a into z and z squared is y into b
rendu geometric means unte a y z b G P lo untay
each term squared is the product of the terms on either side
heard_as: a plus b is two x

steps.why: Two geometric means between a and b make a four-term G.P., and in a G.P. each term squared equals the product of its neighbours. Those two relations are all this identity needs.
common_mistakes: Putting a, y, z, b in A.P. instead of G.P., which is the condition for the arithmetic means question.
Writing y² = ab, which is the rule for a single geometric mean, not for two.

steps.label: Build y³ + z³
steps.margin_note: Second mark. The move is y³ = y × y²; after it the factor yz comes out and a + b = 2x finishes the proof.
steps.memory_tip: Multiply each square by its own term to make a cube, then take yz outside.
lines: y³ + z³ = ayz + byz = yz(a + b) = yz(2x)

recall.must_convey: That y³ = ayz and z³ = byz, so y³ + z³ = yz(a + b) = yz(2x) = 2xyz.
accept: multiply y squared by y to get a y z
multiply z squared by z to get b y z
take y z common and a plus b is two x
y z common teeste a plus b two x avuthundi
the sum of the cubes is two x y z

steps.why: Multiplying each squared relation by its own term turns the squares into cubes and leaves yz as a common factor. The bracket that remains is a + b, which the arithmetic mean has already replaced by 2x.
common_mistakes: Factorising y³ + z³ as (y + z)(y² − yz + z²): correct algebra, but a dead end here, because neither mean condition fits that bracket.
Leaving the answer as yz(a + b) without putting a + b = 2x.
